name: UltraFusion-Extreme-Cases
description: A small real-shot stress-test set for UltraFusion inference under extreme exposure gaps, handheld motion, saturation-heavy regions, and pre-alignment failures.
format: Each scene folder contains ue.* for the under-exposed input and oe.* for the over-exposed input.

scenes.notes: Use as a basic real-shot stress case.
Larger image pair for tiled inference.
The input dimensions are transposed. The dataset loader applies EXIF transpose and rotates the over-exposed image when the pair dimensions are swapped.
